device_analysis.topology: Directional coupler with tapered coupling region
device_analysis.description: Two waveguides that run parallel, approach each other via tapers, maintain close proximity for coupling, then separate via inverse tapers
device_analysis.function: Optical power coupling between two waveguides via evanescent field overlap

key_parameters.input_width: Width of the input/output waveguides at the edges
key_parameters.taper_width: Minimum width at the tips where coupling occurs
key_parameters.gap: Vertical separation between the two waveguides in the coupling region
key_parameters.coupling_length: Horizontal length of the parallel coupling section
key_parameters.taper_length: Length of the taper transition from input_width to taper_width

geometry_observations.upper_waveguide: Tapers from wide to narrow, parallel section, tapers back to wide
geometry_observations.lower_waveguide: Mirror of upper waveguide with vertical offset (gap)

iterations.change_made: Initial attempt with linear tapers. WRONG - target has smooth S-curves (sine/cosine transitions), not linear tapers. Need to use bends or parametric curves. Also input_width too narrow.
Added smooth cosine tapers but IoU worse. Height mismatch: GDS=1.85um vs target=3um. Gap too large (0.5um), input_width still too small. Need input_width~1.4um, gap~0.2um to fill 3um footprint.

Adjusted gap=0.2, input_width=1.4 but IoU still dropping. TOPOLOGY WRONG: I modeled narrow-tipped tapers. Target shows WIDE waveguides throughout (1.3-1.4um) that only slightly converge/diverge, NOT aggressive tapers to thin tips. Need taper_width~1.2um (minor shape change), not 0.25um.

MAJOR improvement! Switched to wide waveguides (taper_width=1.25, gap=0.1). Red extra in middle = coupling_length too long. Blue missing at edges = need more curvature at ends, slightly wider overall.
Slight improvement. Still have red middle (straight section visible). Target appears to be ONE continuous smooth curve end-to-end, not taper-straight-taper. Will try fully parametric curve.
Tried fully continuous curve - IoU dropped. Best was iter 5 (0.477). Restoring that version.
